details:
MARSCOPE – Project Details

MARSCOPE is an interactive Mars exploration application that helps users study the planet's surface through satellite data and scientific observations. It brings together datasets from missions such as Viking, MOLA, THEMIS and TES. Users can explore Martian regions, examine surface features, discover Jezero Crater and study distances between scientific targets through interactive maps and visual tools.

The project benefits students, space enthusiasts and researchers by making complex planetary data easier to access, understand and explore. Its intended impact is to encourage interest in space science and improve awareness of how satellite technology helps us understand other planets.

The application was developed using the Emergent AI development platform, which helped generate the application and its code. It uses software-based tools, interactive mapping and satellite datasets. No physical hardware was required.

MARSCOPE is creative because it combines multiple scientific datasets into one interactive exploration platform rather than presenting information through ordinary text. Our team considered scientific accuracy, ease of use, accessibility, visual presentation and the usefulness of the information while developing the project.
